1.english_reference: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me , saying ,

2.english_reference: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying ,

traditions.WLC: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְ קָֽרָאתָ֩ בְ אָזְנֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לֵ אמֹ֗ר
traditions.VUL: Vade , et clama in áuribus Ierúsalem , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying ,

traditions.LXX: Καὶ εἶπεν Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ;

2.english_reference: I remember thee , the kindness of thy youth , the love of thine espousals ,

traditions.WLC: זָכַ֤רְתִּי לָ ךְ֙ חֶ֣סֶד נְעוּרַ֔יִ ךְ אַהֲבַ֖ת כְּלוּלֹתָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: Ἐμνήσθην ἐλέους νεότητός σου καὶ ἀγάπης τελειώσεως αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Recordátus sum tui , míserans adolescéntiam tuam , et caritátem desponsatiónis tuæ ,
traditions.KJV: I remember thee , the kindness of thy youth , the love of thine espousals ,

2.english_reference: when thou wentest after me in the wilderness , in a land [ that was ] not sown .

traditions.WLC: לֶכְתֵּ֤ ךְ אַחֲרַ י֙ בַּ מִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּ אֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א זְרוּעָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐξακολουθῆσαί σε τῷ ἁγίῳ Ἰσραήλ , λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: quando secúta es me in desérto , in terra , quæ non seminátur .
traditions.KJV: when thou wentest after me in the wilderness , in a land [ that was ] not sown .

3.english_reference: Israel [ was ] holiness unto the LORD , [ and ] the firstfruits of his increase :

traditions.WLC: קֹ֤דֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַ יהוָ֔ה רֵאשִׁ֖ית תְּבוּאָתֹ֑ ה
traditions.LXX: ἅγιος Ἰσραὴλ τῷ κυρίῳ , ἀρχὴ γενημάτων αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Sanctus Israel Dómino , primítiæ frugum eius :
traditions.KJV: Israel [ was ] holiness unto the LORD , [ and ] the firstfruits of his increase :

3.english_reference: all that devour him shall offend ;

traditions.LXX: πάντες οἱ ἔσθοντες αὐτὸν πλημμελήσουσιν ,
traditions.KJV: all that devour him shall offend ;

3.english_reference: evil shall come upon them , saith the LORD .

traditions.WLC: רָעָ֛ה תָּבֹ֥א אֲלֵי הֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: κακὰ ἥξει ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς , φησὶν Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: mala vénient super eos , dicit Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: evil shall come upon them , saith the LORD .

4.english_reference: Hear ye the word of the LORD , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :

traditions.WLC: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ כָֽל מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: Ἀκούσατε λόγον Κυρίου , οἶκος Ἰακὼβ καὶ πᾶσα πατριὰ οἴκου Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: Audíte verbum Dómini domus Iacob , et omnes cognatiónes domus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Hear ye the word of the LORD , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :

traditions.LXX: τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ,

5.english_reference: What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me ,

traditions.WLC: מַה מָּצְא֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵי כֶ֥ם בִּ י֙ עָ֔וֶל כִּ֥י רָחֲק֖וּ מֵ עָלָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: Τί εὕροσαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ πλημμέλημα , ὅτι ἀπέστησαν μακρὰν ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Quid invenérunt patres vestri in me iniquitátis , quia elongavérunt a me ,
traditions.KJV: What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me ,

5.english_reference: and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּֽלְכ֛וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַ הֶ֖בֶל וַ יֶּהְבָּֽלוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπίσω τῶν ματαίων καὶ ἐματαιώθησαν ?
traditions.VUL: et ambulavérunt post vanitátem , et vani facti sunt ?
traditions.KJV: and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?

6.english_reference: Neither said they , Where [ is ] the LORD

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ εἶπαν Ποῦ ἐστιν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Et non dixérunt : Ubi est Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Neither said they , Where [ is ] the LORD

6.english_reference: that brought us up out of the land of Egypt ,

traditions.WLC: הַ מַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖ נוּ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: qui ascéndere nos fecit de terra Ægýpti :
traditions.KJV: that brought us up out of the land of Egypt ,

6.english_reference: that led us through the wilderness , through a land of deserts and of pits ,

traditions.WLC: הַ מּוֹלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜ נוּ בַּ מִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּ אֶ֨רֶץ עֲרָבָ֤ה וְ שׁוּחָה֙
traditions.LXX: ὁ καθοδηγήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν γῇ ἀπείρῳ καὶ ἀβάτῳ ,
traditions.VUL: qui tradúxit nos per desértum , per terram inhabitábilem et ínviam ,
traditions.KJV: that led us through the wilderness , through a land of deserts and of pits ,

6.english_reference: through a land of drought , and of the shadow of death ,

traditions.LXX: ἐν γῇ ἀνύδρῳ καὶ ἀκάρπῳ ,
traditions.VUL: per terram sitis , et imáginem mortis ,
traditions.KJV: through a land of drought , and of the shadow of death ,

6.english_reference: through a land that no man passed through , and where no man dwelt ?

traditions.WLC: בְּ אֶ֗רֶץ לֹֽא עָ֤בַר בָּ הּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ לֹֽא יָשַׁ֥ב אָדָ֖ם שָֽׁם
traditions.LXX: ἐν γῇ ἐν ᾗ οὐ διώδευσεν ἐν αὐτῇ οὐθὲν καὶ οὐ κατῴκησεν ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖ ?
traditions.VUL: per terram , in qua non ambulávit vir , neque habitávit homo ?
traditions.KJV: through a land that no man passed through , and where no man dwelt ?

7.english_reference: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof ;

traditions.WLC: וָ אָבִ֤יא אֶתְ כֶם֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ כַּרְמֶ֔ל לֶ אֱכֹ֥ל פִּרְיָ֖ הּ וְ טוּבָ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤγαγον ὑμᾶς εἰς τὸν Κάρμηλον , τοῦ φαγεῖν ὑμᾶς τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ἀγαθὰ αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Et indúxi vos in terram Carméli , ut comederétis fructum eius et óptima illíus :
traditions.KJV: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof ;

7.english_reference: but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ וַ תְּטַמְּא֣וּ אֶת אַרְצִ֔ י וְ נַחֲלָתִ֥ י שַׂמְתֶּ֖ם לְ תוֹעֵבָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσήλθατε καὶ ἐμιάνατε τὴν γῆν μου , καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν μου ἔθεσθε εἰς βδέλυγμα .
traditions.VUL: et ingréssi contaminástis terram meam , et hereditátem meam posuístis in abominatiónem .
traditions.KJV: but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .

8.english_reference: The priests said not , Where [ is ] the LORD ?

traditions.WLC: הַ כֹּהֲנִ֗ים לֹ֤א אָֽמְרוּ֙ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: οἱ ἱερεῖς οὐκ εἶπαν Ποῦ ἐστιν Κύριος ?
traditions.VUL: Sacerdótes non dixérunt : Ubi est Dóminus ?
traditions.KJV: The priests said not , Where [ is ] the LORD ?

8.english_reference: and they that handle the law knew me not :

traditions.WLC: וְ תֹפְשֵׂ֤י הַ תּוֹרָה֙ לֹ֣א יְדָע֔וּ נִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἀντεχόμενοι τοῦ νόμου οὐκ ἠπίσταντό με ,
traditions.KJV: and they that handle the law knew me not :

8.english_reference: the pastors also transgressed against me ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ רֹעִ֖ים פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ποιμένες ἠσέβουν εἰς ἐμέ ,
traditions.VUL: et pastóres prævaricáti sunt in me ,
traditions.KJV: the pastors also transgressed against me ,

8.english_reference: and the prophets prophesied by Baal , and walked after [ things that ] do not profit .

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ נְּבִיאִים֙ נִבְּא֣וּ בַ בַּ֔עַל וְ אַחֲרֵ֥י לֹֽא יוֹעִ֖לוּ הָלָֽכוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον τῇ Βάαλ καὶ ὀπίσω ἀνωφελοῦς ἐπορεύθησαν .
traditions.VUL: et prophétæ prophetavérunt in Baal , et idóla secúti sunt .
traditions.KJV: and the prophets prophesied by Baal , and walked after [ things that ] do not profit .

9.english_reference: Wherefore I will yet plead with you , saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן עֹ֛ד אָרִ֥יב אִתְּ כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἔτι κριθήσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: Proptérea adhuc iudício conténdam vobíscum , ait Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Wherefore I will yet plead with you , saith the LORD ,

9.english_reference: and with your children ’s children will I plead .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י בְנֵי כֶ֖ם אָרִֽיב
traditions.LXX: καὶ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν ὑμῶν κριθήσομαι .
traditions.KJV: and with your children ’s children will I plead .

10.english_reference: For pass over the isles of Chittim , and see ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י עִבְר֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י כִתִּיִּים֙ וּ רְא֔וּ
traditions.LXX: διότι ἔλθετε εἰς νήσους Χεττιεὶμ καὶ ἴδετε ,
traditions.VUL: Transíte ad ínsulas Cethim , et vidéte :
traditions.KJV: For pass over the isles of Chittim , and see ;

10.english_reference: and send unto Kedar , and consider diligently ,

traditions.WLC: וְ קֵדָ֛ר שִׁלְח֥וּ וְ הִֽתְבּוֹנְנ֖וּ מְאֹ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰς Κηδὰρ ἀποστείλατε καὶ νοήσατε σφόδρα ,
traditions.VUL: et in Cedar míttite , et consideráte veheménter :
traditions.KJV: and send unto Kedar , and consider diligently ,

10.english_reference: and see if there be such a thing .

traditions.WLC: וּ רְא֕וּ הֵ֥ן הָיְתָ֖ה כָּ זֹֽאת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἴδετε εἰ γέγονεν τοιαῦτα ,
traditions.VUL: et vidéte si factum est huiuscémodi .
traditions.KJV: and see if there be such a thing .

11.english_reference: Hath a nation changed [ their ] gods

traditions.LXX: εἰ ἀλλάξονται ἔθνη θεοὺς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.KJV: Hath a nation changed [ their ] gods ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτοι οὐκ εἰσὶν θεοί ·
traditions.VUL: et certe ipsi non sunt dii :
traditions.KJV: which [ are ] yet no gods ?

11.english_reference: but my people have changed their glory

traditions.WLC: וְ עַמִּ֛ י הֵמִ֥יר כְּבוֹד֖ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ λαός μου ἠλλάξατο τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: pópulus vero meus mutávit glóriam suam
traditions.KJV: but my people have changed their glory

11.english_reference: for [ that which ] doth not profit .

traditions.LXX: ἐξ ἧς οὐκ ὠφεληθήσονται .
traditions.KJV: for [ that which ] doth not profit .

12.english_reference: Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this

traditions.LXX: ἐξέστη ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐπὶ τούτῳ
traditions.KJV: Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this ,

12.english_reference: and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔφριξεν ἐπὶ πλεῖον σφόδρα ,
traditions.KJV: and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate ,

traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD .

13.english_reference: For my people have committed two evils ;

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שְׁתַּ֥יִם רָע֖וֹת עָשָׂ֣ה עַמִּ֑ י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι δύο καὶ πονηρὰ ἐποίησεν ὁ λαός μου ·
traditions.VUL: Duo enim mala fecit pópulus meus :
traditions.KJV: For my people have committed two evils ;

13.english_reference: they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters ,

traditions.WLC: אֹתִ֨ י עָזְב֜וּ מְק֣וֹר מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֗ים
traditions.LXX: ἐμὲ ἐνκατέλιπον , πηγὴν ὕδατος ζωῆς ,
traditions.KJV: they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters , [ and ]

traditions.LXX: καὶ ὤρυξαν ἑαυτοῖς λάκκους
traditions.KJV: hewed them out cisterns ,

traditions.LXX: συντετριμμένους
traditions.KJV: broken cisterns ,

traditions.LXX: οἳ οὐ δυνήσονται ὕδωρ συνέχειν .
traditions.KJV: that can hold no water .

traditions.LXX: μὴ δοῦλός ἐστιν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.KJV: [ Is ] Israel a servant ? [ is ]

traditions.LXX: ἢ οἰκογενής ἐστιν ?
traditions.KJV: he a homeborn [ slave ] ?

traditions.LXX: διὰ τί εἰς προνομὴν ἐγένετο ?
traditions.VUL: quare ergo factus est in prædam ?
traditions.KJV: why is he spoiled ?

15.english_reference: The young lions roared upon him , [ and ] yelled ,

traditions.WLC: עָלָי ו֙ יִשְׁאֲג֣וּ כְפִרִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ קוֹלָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν ὠρύοντο λέοντες καὶ ἔδωκαν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Super eum rugiérunt leónes , et dedérunt vocem suam :
traditions.KJV: The young lions roared upon him , [ and ] yelled ,

15.english_reference: and they made his land waste :

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשִׁ֤יתוּ אַרְצ וֹ֙ לְ שַׁמָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: οἳ ἔταξαν τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ εἰς ἔρημον ,
traditions.KJV: and they made his land waste :

15.english_reference: his cities are burned without inhabitant .

traditions.WLC: עָרָ֥י ו נצתה מִ בְּלִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב
traditions.LXX: καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτοῦ κατεσκάφησαν παρὰ τὸ μὴ κατοικεῖσθαι .
traditions.VUL: civitátes eius exústæ sunt , et non est qui hábitet in eis .
traditions.KJV: his cities are burned without inhabitant .

16.english_reference: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head .

traditions.WLC: גַּם בְּנֵי נֹ֖ף ו תחפנס יִרְע֖וּ ךְ קָדְקֹֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ υἱοὶ Μέμφεως καὶ Ταφνὰς ἔγνωσάν σε καὶ κατέπαιζόν σου ·
traditions.VUL: Fílii quoque Mémpheos et Taphnes constupravérunt te usque ad vérticem .
traditions.KJV: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head .

traditions.LXX: οὐχὶ ταῦτα ἐποίησέν σοι τὸ καταλιπεῖν σε ἐμέ ?

17.english_reference: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself ,

traditions.WLC: הֲ לוֹא זֹ֖את תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּ֑ ךְ
traditions.VUL: Numquid non istud factum est tibi ,
traditions.KJV: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself ,

17.english_reference: in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God ,

traditions.WLC: עָזְבֵ ךְ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִ ךְ
traditions.KJV: in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God ,

17.english_reference: when he led thee by the way ?

traditions.WLC: בְּ עֵ֖ת מוֹלִיכֵ֥ ךְ בַּ דָּֽרֶךְ
traditions.VUL: eo témpore , quo ducébat te per viam ?
traditions.KJV: when he led thee by the way ?

traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος ὁ θεός σου .

18.english_reference: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה מַה לָּ ךְ֙ לְ דֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν τί σοι καὶ τῇ ὁδῷ Αἰγύπτου
traditions.VUL: Et nunc quid tibi vis in via Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt ,

18.english_reference: to drink the waters of Sihor ?

traditions.LXX: τοῦ πιεῖν ὕδωρ Γηών ?
traditions.KJV: to drink the waters of Sihor ?

18.english_reference: or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מַה לָּ ךְ֙ לְ דֶ֣רֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר
traditions.LXX: καὶ τί σοι καὶ τῇ ὁδῷ Ἀσσυρίων
traditions.VUL: et quid tibi cum via Assyriórum ,
traditions.KJV: or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria ,

18.english_reference: to drink the waters of the river ?

traditions.LXX: τοῦ πιεῖν ὕδωρ ποταμῶν ?
traditions.KJV: to drink the waters of the river ?

19.english_reference: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee ,

traditions.LXX: παιδεύσει σε ἡ ἀποστασία σου ,
traditions.KJV: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee ,

19.english_reference: and thy backslidings shall reprove thee :

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ κακία σου ἐλέγξει σε ·
traditions.KJV: and thy backslidings shall reprove thee :

19.english_reference: know therefore and see that [ it is ] an evil [ thing ] and bitter ,

traditions.WLC: וּ דְעִ֤י וּ רְאִי֙ כִּי רַ֣ע וָ מָ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνῶθι καὶ ἴδε ὅτι πικρόν σοι
traditions.VUL: Scito , et vide quia malum et amárum est
traditions.KJV: know therefore and see that [ it is ] an evil [ thing ] and bitter ,

19.english_reference: that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God ,

traditions.WLC: עָזְבֵ֖ ךְ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: τὸ καταλιπεῖν σε ἐμέ , λέγει Κύριος ὁ θεός σου ·
